name: video_assemble
description: Assemble rendered segments in storyboard order. Per-segment plans use a short crossfade by default, overlapping pictures and sound; choose cut for a direct join or dip for a scene change. Fails listing any segment that has not been rendered yet.

output_file.description: Absolute output mp4 path; defaults to outputDir/final/<planId>.mp4.

ffmpeg_path.description: ffmpeg executable; defaults to ffmpeg on PATH.

transition.description: Defaults to crossfade: overlap adjacent pictures and audio. cut joins directly; dip fades through black. Only per_segment assembly applies transitions.

transition_seconds.description: Positive overlap duration for crossfade (default 0.4s), or dip half-width (default 0.25s). Capped at half of either adjacent clip. Crossfades shorten the total by their overlaps.
